hooks.text: A shockwave nearly destroyed the first Space Shuttle at liftoff.
The first shuttle launch was a success that almost burned.
One unexpected shockwave ripped 16 tiles off the Space Shuttle.

title: The Secret Eye That Saved STS-1
description: NASA's first shuttle mission faced a hidden disaster when a violent shockwave tore the ship's heat shield apart.

beats.text: A shockwave nearly destroyed the first Space Shuttle at liftoff.
beats.visual: Space Shuttle Columbia STS-1 liftoff from Launch Pad 39A, 1981

beats.text: NASA expected a massive roar on the launch pad.
beats.visual: Launch pad water sound suppression system releasing water deluge at Kennedy Space Center
queries: Kennedy Space Center water sound suppression

beats.text: But ignition created a shockwave more violent than predicted.
beats.visual: Close-up of Space Shuttle Columbia engines at the moment of ignition, 1981

beats.text: This wave hit the ground and slammed into Columbia.
beats.visual: Slow-motion footage of exhaust and pressure waves beneath a shuttle launch

beats.text: The force was enough to rip 16 tiles away.
beats.visual: Space Shuttle Columbia missing thermal protection tiles on the orbital maneuvering system pod, 1981

beats.text: Commander John Young feared they would burn up during reentry.
beats.visual: Official portrait of STS-1 Commander John Young in his flight suit, 1981

beats.text: Since mission control couldn’t see the damage, NASA got desperate.
beats.visual: Mission control specialists at consoles during the STS-1 flight, 1981

beats.text: They used a top-secret spy satellite to photograph the ship.
beats.visual: Artist's concept of the KH-11 KENNEN reconnaissance satellite in Earth orbit

beats.text: The secret images confirmed the crew was safe.
beats.visual: Space Shuttle Columbia landing on the lake bed at Edwards Air Force Base, 1981
queries: STS-1 landing Edwards Air Force Base

beats.text: A secret eye saved the shuttle from that shockwave.
beats.visual: Official STS-1 mission insignia patch showing Columbia launching into orbit

better_than_last: Applied the rule of cosmic-scale stakes by focusing the hook on the violent physical destruction of the spacecraft's heat shield.
